name: redsat
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets and a language server client (diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, outline, inlay hints) for the RedSAT language (.rsat).

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, the language server is started only from the user-level `redsat.server.path` / `redsat.server.useWsl` settings; workspace values are ignored.

redsat.server.enabled.markdownDescription: Start the RedSAT language server (`redsat lsp`) for diagnostics, completion, hover, go to definition, outline and inlay hints. Syntax highlighting and snippets work either way.

redsat.server.path.markdownDescription: The `redsat` executable, invoked with the argument `lsp`. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; an absolute path is used as is. When the server runs through WSL (see `#redsat.server.useWsl#`), this is resolved inside WSL by a login shell, so `~/.cargo/bin` is on `PATH` and a leading `~/` is expanded.

enumDescriptions: On Windows, run the server through WSL when `redsat.server.path` cannot be started directly.
On Windows, always run the server through WSL.
redsat.server.useWsl.markdownDescription: Whether a local Windows window runs the server through WSL (`wsl.exe -e bash -lc "exec <path> lsp"`). Ignored on Linux and macOS, including WSL remote windows, where the server always runs directly.

redsat.trace.server.markdownDescription: Detail of the LSP message trace. Tracing is switched on by setting the log level of the *RedSAT Language Server* output channel to **Trace** (gear icon in the Output panel, or *Developer: Set Log Level…*).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --minify
